Callout.Name: Body Found in the River
Callout.Message: Body found by a fisherman in the river.

Script.Line: It caught on the branch and I thought it was a coat at first.
I have not been in the water. I have not touched anything.
It has been there a while. That is all I can tell you.

Lines.Approach: A fisherman has found somebody in the water. Do not let anybody near it until you have been there.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
